note: selection remains pending gates; if gates fail this config is superseded, not rewritten
retry_policy: none: single attempt per query, fail-closed canonical status
rate_limit_handling: HTTP 429 maps to RATE_LIMITED status; no retries; no backoff storm
auth: Bearer token from project .env.local (mode 0600); never printed, logged, or persisted
fallback_activation_rule: composite: site-direct first; external only consulted when site-direct yields no SUCCESS with results; every switch logged

benchmark_run_parameters.constrained_include_domains_rule: kommune.no domain pattern per municipality slug only; never gold-URL-derived; Stage-A known roots not injected
benchmark_run_parameters.budget_note: one-off diagnostic benchmark; runtime budget defaults above still apply to production composition

gate_basis_preregistered.rationale: CONSTRAINED uses known-domain knowledge unavailable in the failure scenarios the fallback exists for; it is reported as diagnostic and cannot rescue a GENERAL failure
gate_basis_preregistered.constrained_role: diagnostic only; cannot substitute for GENERAL gate result

provenance_doctrine: search output is discovery evidence only; final route provenance always from original public URL via FetchProvider
